actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or larger target in its space. Hit: 51 (4d20 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 22). If the target is an object  it is held. Until the grapple or hold ends  the targets speed is reduced to 0  and the sea serpents coils attack automatically hits the target. If an attacker subjects the serpent to a critical hit  this grapple or hold ends.
